title: helianthemum myrtifolium subsp. marifolium
intro: Helianthemum myrtifolium subsp. marifolium, commonly known as Rock Rose, is a plant species belonging to the family Cistaceae. Rock Rose has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, reduce fever, and combat infections. The therapeutic actions of Rock Rose include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce stress and anxiety, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Rock Rose include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoid saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
